title: The holder restricts who can open a shared record
description: A family shares a record by handing over a link, not the record. The person who holds it decides who can open it and for how long: a passcode they choose and can say aloud, an expiry, and the means to withdraw the link. Owner, 2026-11-05: “user should be able to restrict access”.

statements.label: A passcode the holder sets
statements.requirement: Sharing a record as a link SHALL let the holder protect it with a passcode they choose, and the record SHALL NOT be released without it.
statements.capability: protect the link to my child's record with a passcode I choose
statements.benefit: only the person I tell can open it

successCriteria.criterion: Opening a shared link with a wrong passcode releases nothing and is recorded in the home country's access log (J4.1, example AuditEvent TrustDemoJ41WrongPasscode).

statements.label: An expiry the holder sets
statements.requirement: The holder SHALL be able to choose how long a shared link stays valid, and an expired link SHALL release nothing.
statements.capability: choose how long the link works
statements.benefit: access ends when the visit is over

successCriteria.criterion: A link opened after the expiry the holder chose releases nothing.

statements.label: The holder withdraws a link
statements.requirement: The holder SHOULD be able to withdraw a shared link before it expires.
statements.capability: withdraw a link I no longer want used
statements.benefit: a lost phone or a changed mind does not leave the record open
